lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: You're the Word of God,
The Father, from before the world began
Every storm and every platter has been fashioned by Your hand
All creation holds together by the power of your voice
Let the skies declare your glory
Let the land and seas rejoice
You're the author of creation
You're the Lord of every man

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: And your cry of love rings out across the land
Yet you left the gaze of angels Came
To see and save the lost And
Exchanged the joy of heaven For
The anguish of the cross
With the bread you fed the hungry With
The word you stole the sea
Yet how sorrowfully you suffer

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Let the guilty make afraid You're the author of creation
You're the Lord of every life
And you'll cry your loudest things out across the land

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: With a shout you rose victorious
Resting victory from the grave
And ascended into heaven,
Leading captives in the way
Now you stand before the Father,
Interceding for your own From
Each tribe and time and nation,
You are leading sinners home

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: You're the author of creation
You're the Lord of every man And
Your cry of love rings out across the line You're
You're the author of creation
The Lord of every man
And your cry of love rings out across the line
